The C.UTF-8 re-run has finished, and acceptance item 2 is still not met on my branch. Every test passed (`unit-node` 2632/2632, `unit-web` 1787/1787, `unit-formula-nocodegen` 259 passed, 2 skipped), but the run exited 1. The cause is one test-runner error, `[vitest-worker]: Timeout calling "onTaskUpdate"`: under heavy load, a test worker didn't get its status update back to the main runner in time. No test assertion failed, but Vitest counts the error as a failure, so I'm reporting this run as a non-zero exit, not a pass.

Where `pnpm test` stands on the final tree:
- **C.UTF-8:** all tests passed; exit 1 from that runner timeout.
- **Locale unset:** `unit-node` and the formula tests passed. 5 `unit-web` tests failed, all in pages I didn't touch, and those same tests passed in other runs.

This is recorded in the handback as section 8b, and the log is `rerun-test-c-utf8.log` in the evidence folder.

The orchestrator still needs to run these on the merged tree, ideally with less load on the host: `pnpm test` in both locales, `pnpm -r build`, the full integration suite, and the end-of-task DG5 historical validation. All changes remain uncommitted on `dg6/be-g`.
